gbm_population_evidence.quote: Participants must have histologically confirmed diagnosis of glioblastoma or variants.

candidate_evidence.quote: This research study involves a combination of two drugs:
Abemaciclib, twice daily oral at specified dose for 21 day cycle

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Participants must be at first relapse of GBM.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Effects of abemaciclib and pembrolizumab on tumor cell proliferation and tumor cell death will be measured using immunohistochemistry for pRB1, Ki-67 and Cleaved Caspase 3

role_evidence.quote: This research study involves a combination of two drugs:

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: humanized monoclonal antibody designed to block the action of the receptor PD-1

role_evidence.quote: This research study involves a combination of two drugs:

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: enters the brain and stops CDK 4 and CDK 6 from making cells

source_quote.quote: Inactivation of CDKN2A/B or C in the tumor by homozygous deletion
Validation of wild-type RB status (no deletion/losses more than single copy by copy number or sequencing data; and/or no inactivating mutations or rearrangement by sequencing).
IDH1/2 mutation in any prior biopsy.
Effects of abemaciclib and pembrolizumab on tumor cell proliferation and tumor cell death will be measured using immunohistochemistry for pRB1, Ki-67 and Cleaved Caspase 3

coder_notes: Eligibility requires CDKN2A/B (or C) inactivation with intact RB1 for all cohorts (the Surgery Arm label repeats this). IDH-mutant tumours are excluded (IDH row is an exclusion, so coded as eligibility with no candidate match). Registry lists ages CHILD, ADULT but inclusion requires age 18 or older.
